Variants.Content: Sandstone City is located in the dry desert in the hinterland of Dorne and is the ancestral castle of the Kogel family. It belongs to Dorne, ruled by Sunspear, but is far away from the rich valleys and seaports; wells, water storage, drought-tolerant herds, and roads across the sand determine how many people and riders the castle can support.

Entry Sandstone Local families also rely on wells, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and travel to avoid the hot sun; if any road, well, or dock fails, the cost falls first on them.

Entry Sandstone They also recognize Dornish accents, laws and credentials; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar or horse's hoof.

Entry Sandstone If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

The traces left by generations of people in Sandstone City are half hidden in the stone walls, wooden beams, iron doors, tombs, and seams repaired by generations. The other half are hidden in the shared memories of the Seven Gods, the legacy of Rhoynar, and the different bloodlines under the prince's rule. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Sandstone They care about wells and springs, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and routes to avoid the scorching sun. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
